fishing: WHEN: Tue Oct 20 moderate NE winds ~10-15kt, better early/late; residual chop possible. PASSES-BEACH: snook slowing, redfish/flounder near passes on live shrimp/gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish & mangrove snapper around docks/mangroves, trout on flats (Fishin Franks/local reports). NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper 40-50ft, cobia migrating, weather-dependent. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, cutbait, pilchards.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present in Charlotte/Lee/Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10-20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches latest samples). No advisory.
fpl: Charlotte/Sarasota small isolated outages only, no major Englewood impact.
